part.overload.title: Overload
part.overload.summary: A piece with two duties cannot fulfil both: a check or a capture forces it to let go of one.
ex.ov.DWtI4: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.ov.DWtI4.hint: The knight on c3 defends the white queen on e4. Look for a check that only the knight can answer.
ex.ov.DWtI4.solution: 22...Rd1+! gives check, and only the knight on c3 can capture the rook. After 23.Nxd1, the queen on e4 is left undefended, and 23...Qxe4 captures it.
ex.ov.Chiv8: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.ov.Chiv8.hint: The rook on c8 defends the black queen on c4. Look for a check that forces that rook off the c-file.
ex.ov.Chiv8.solution: 30.Rd8+! gives check, and the rook on c8 must capture. After 30...Rxd8, the queen on c4 is left undefended, and 31.Qxc4 captures it.
ex.ov.2YRoJ: Play as Black and find the best move. Your queen on f3 is attacked by the bishop and the queen.
ex.ov.2YRoJ.hint: The rook on c1 defends the white queen on c3. Look for a check on the king on e1.
ex.ov.2YRoJ.solution: 19...Rd1+! gives check, and only the rook on c1 can capture, because the queen on f3 watches d1. After 20.Rxd1, the queen on c3 is left undefended, and 20...Qxc3+ captures it with check.
ex.ov.pTV8S: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.ov.pTV8S.hint: The bishop on f6 defends the rook on g5. Look for a check that the bishop has to block.
ex.ov.pTV8S.solution: 25.Qh6+! gives check along the diagonal, and the bishop on f6 blocks on g7. After 25...Bg7, the rook on g5 is left undefended, and 26.Qxg5 captures it.
ex.ov.uZFh9: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.ov.uZFh9.hint: The rook on d8 defends the black queen on d2. Which other square does that rook also guard?
ex.ov.uZFh9.solution: 25.Re8+! gives check, and only the rook on d8 can capture. After 25...Rxe8, the queen on d2 is left undefended, and 26.Qxd2 captures it.
ex.ov.7pUIL: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.ov.7pUIL.hint: The rook on e1 defends the white queen on e4. Which other piece does that rook also protect?
ex.ov.7pUIL.solution: 24...Rxf1+! captures the bishop with check. The king cannot recapture, because the bishop on h3 defends f1, and the rook on e1 must capture. After 25.Rxf1, the queen on e4 is left undefended, and 25...Qxe4 captures it.
ex.ov.kGCK8: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.ov.kGCK8.hint: The rook on f2 defends the white queen on d2. Which move forces that rook off the second rank?
ex.ov.kGCK8.solution: 29...Nf3+! checks the king on g1 and attacks the queen on d2. If the king runs, the knight captures the queen. After 30.Rxf3, the rook leaves the second rank, and 30...Qxd2 captures the queen.
ex.ov.eF6AG: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.ov.eF6AG.hint: The rook on e3 defends the white queen on e1. Which move forces that rook off the e-file?
ex.ov.eF6AG.solution: 42...Nf3+! checks the king on g1 and attacks the queen on e1. If the king runs, the knight captures the queen. After 43.Rxf3, the rook leaves the e-file, and 43...Qxe1+ captures the queen with check.
